w.t:
PORT OF ROTTERDAM BAS 061/2026
Rotterdam/Yangtzekanaal
Bijzondere voorzichtigheid / Special caution
Valid from 15 Apr 2026 22:00 UTC to 31 Dec 2026 22:59 UTC
1. From Thursday 16 April 2026 to Tuesday 31 December 2026, the pontoon VOW 102 will take berth in the Yangtzekanaal near shoreside number 9848. This due to the construction works in the Yukonhaven.
2. The pontoon will be used for the transport of soil to and from the project site in the Yukonhaven. Mariners are requested to pay extra attention to the vessel movements of the involved working vessels between the Yukonhaven and reclamation area K, west of Alexiahaven P90/P91.
3. Vessels are requested to maintain contact with Sector Europoort on VHF channel 66 to stay informed of any updates or changes.
4. Vessels are requested to pass carefully and keep sufficient distance from the pontoon and associated work vessels.
5. Depending on progress of the works, the duration may be extended or shortened as deemed necessary.

w.id: Netherlands Port of Rotterdam Port of Rotterdam BAS 182/2025
w.t:
PORT OF ROTTERDAM BAS 182/2025
Rotterdam
Mededeling / Announcement
Valid from 14 Sep 2025 22:00 UTC to 31 Dec 2050 22:59 UTC
1. Met ingang van 12 januari 2023 zijn een vijftigtal ligplaatsen in het Rotterdamse havengebied aangewezen als gemengd afmeren ligplaats.

w.id: Netherlands Port of Rotterdam Port of Rotterdam BAS 134/2025
w.t:
PORT OF ROTTERDAM BAS 134/2025
Rotterdam/ Maasmond
Bijzondere voorzichtigheid / Special caution
Valid from 09 Jul 2025 22:00 UTC until further notice
1. The work taking place in the Maasmond precautionary area for the construction of a pipeline will resume on July 10, 2025.
2. The pipeline will be laid from KP (kilometer point) 4.488 (52-01.4N 004-02.1E/WGS 84) to platform P18-A (52-07.6N 003-56.3E). The coordinates per kilometer point of the pipeline in WGS 84 are:
KP2 52-00.1N 004-01.4E
KP3 52-00.6N 004-01.6E
KP4 52-01.1N 004-01.9E
KP5 52-01.6N 004-02.2E
KP6 52-02.1N 004-02.4E
KP7 52-02.7N 004-02.6E
KP8 52-03.2N 004-02.7E
KP9 52-03.7N 004-02.5E
KP10 52-04.2N 004-02.0E
KP11 52-04.6N 004-01.4E
KP12 52-05.0N 004-00.8E
KP13 52-05.3N 004-00.2E
KP14 52-05.7N 003-59.5E
KP15 52-06.1N 003-58.9E
KP16 52-06.5N 003-58.3E
KP17 52-06.8N 003-57.7E
KP18 52-07.2N 003-56.9E
KP19 52-07.6N 003-56.4E
3. The work will be carried out by the pipe layer Lorelay with assisting work vessels. Traffic participants are advised to keep themselves informed of the position of the Lorelay.
4. During the time the pipeline lies uncovered on the seabed, the route from KP 3.3 (52-00.8N 004-01.7E) to kilometer point 8 will be closed to maritime traffic.
5. From KP 2.2 to KP 3.3, maritime traffic is permitted for vessels with a maximum draft of 7 meters, a maximum width of 32 meters, and traveling at a maximum speed of 10 knots. These kilometer points are indicated by a virtual ATON.
6. All vessels intending to pass the pipeline route between kilometer point 8 and kilometer point 18 must do so with utmost caution and follow any instructions from the guard vessel, Maasmond VHF3, and Pilot Maas VHF2. The Lorelay will be restricted in its maneuverability and must be passed at a minimum distance of 500 meters on this route.
7. Recreational vessels are advised to follow the designated crossing route between the MV and MN1 buoys and maintain a minimum distance of 500 meters around the Lorelay's operations.
8. The pipeline will then, after being fully laid on the seabed, be stabilized and buried from KP 2.2 (52-00.2N 004-01.4E) to platform P18-A (52-07.6N 003-56.3E).
9. Any changes in the planning and progress of the work will be communicated as soon as possible via a new Notice to Mariners.
10. Hereby Notice to Shipping 109/2025 has been canceled.
